name: Handyman
tagline: Remembers your filter sizes and chore dates, then books the next round
description: The household memory most of us never keep: it stores the furnace filter size, logs when each recurring chore was last done, and works out when the next filter change, water-heater flush and the rest come due. Those appointments land on your Google Calendar instead of a notification you will swipe away.
author: dkmitc
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
